items.detail: Specific examples matter more than a big name.

items.myth: All your LORs can be the same
items.fact: Each LOR shows a new angle
items.detail: One for studies, one for a project, one for work. Different people, different strengths.

items.myth: Ask for LORs in the last week
items.detail: Ask early, and share your resume and goals with them.

youtube.title: Can anyone write your LOR? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
3 big myths about Letters of Recommendation.

Your LOR should come from someone who really knows you, each LOR should show a different strength, and your recommender needs time.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com
